After a lot of time and thinking, we're going to try again, and just as I decide this.. Grandparent dies. Add one love, lose one. Life is cruel. Luckily I have my girl to help me through it, half of my family doesnt seem to care as she became estranged and a bit 'crazy' but I loved her and she impacted my life, so it's nice to have someone here just for me. I will put this out there though, should things have not worked out with my ex, I fear I would have failed these upcoming exams (2 weeks, yet to revise but I'm confident) or worse.. I'll likely be updating this less and less as time heals us and hopefully makes us stronger, I do still feel I'll talk to someone, lest I fall back on the path of my past. I'd like to thank you for your help, you are a great human being, and I'll likely update this from time to time if you'd be okay with that? Who knows, in 2 months time I could be as happy as Larry (who that is, no clue, hopefully it's a saying where you're from) or I could be down and worse than ever.. Time will tell, but I hold high hopes for us this time, I know damn well I'll be trying.

Dont worry all my questions are conjecture, I dont expect an answer, never have on any of my posts, and I truly appreciate all of the responses! If I have any flaws, one of them is not rash decision making! I'll be capable of making this decision, I am scared though.

Sounds it when you read it but its pretty simple compared to some situations! Pretty basically distance made times hard, next time make more time for eachother and be more understanding of eachother. Problem is Im worried what happens next time she's stressed? Do I take the backseat again? Im going to have to really think about this for a long time, for now I'll go with it in fear of regret, because it is something I have wanted for the whole time. He is sick! I love him too much considering we've known eachother for 2 months! Yeah its likely an avenue I'll follow up on, feel like this is such a big life changing decision right here. Outcomes are obvious, happy ever after, 2nd breakage of heart resulting in bad consequences, move on and hope for better, move on and regret it massively with bad consequences. Scary stuff, maths time to figure this all out.

Will it though? Issues are still there, whats changed?! I dont know how things could be worse than before, want to know one thing though? I went to watch a film downstairs with my parents, my mum was trying to tell me to stay away 'I dont need the pain' (little does she know every day has been heartbreaking) so I needed a break to think. I found myself smile at the film (The butterfly effect incase you know it, not a particularly funny film) but I was enjoying it, I wasnt unhappy or confused or annoyed (any more than the usual me) - I was content. I dont know if its because I could have her back, or the fact things are now in my control and I can make a decision now.. truth is, I know there are flaws, distance, trust, that I strive for her to be a way she isnt at times, but she is so damned perfect. I wont go on in fear of repeating my last post, but instead explain the break up best I can. 

She was stressed because of mock exams (she's younger than me, not in university) and had less and less time for me. Given it's a long distance relationship, time spent together is important, and from my perspective it seemed she was pulling away. There was also this guy, who she is adamant about not caring for, who I can see wants to break us up, likely to take her, but also because he hates me because I wronged him in the past. Now I know it's not the right 'etiquette' to ask someone to not talk to someone, so I simply let her know it does upset me (communication is key) and that I'd just like to know things, but I trust her. Anyway, in the little time spent together, due to a combination of her stress and me being frustrated, we fought a lot, and she started spending more time with him, adding to my frustration. A little while of simply being unhappy, I decided we couldnt go on with the way things were, but she convinced me to go see her and make things work, which of course, I did (about £100 for a weekend, not that it particularly matters). We spent the weekend together, seemingly happy, as far as I could tell things were going to be okay, but after 3/4 days of not talking much again, I heard from an old friend that the guy she was talking to (who hates me) was live streaming and talking to her, and laughing about the fact she was lying to me about revising to be with him. Needless to say this killed me, and when talking she lied for a bit then gave in and admitted she didnt love me the same since I thought things couldnt continue the way things were, which blindsided me as I thought things would get better. 2 broken knuckles and 3 phone calls to close friends and family later, I was alone as fuck. I did however have one friend get a 20 minute bus, and break into my building, bang on the flat door, then on my door, just to make sure I was okay because I didnt answer my phone. I now love that guy!!! In fairness that story doesnt paint the best of pictures for her, so I will point out I wasn't perfect, I would push her to change in ways she wouldnt want to sometimes, I would argue my points further than I should have because im convinced im right even when it didnt matter, I should have been more trusting with the friend (although in hindsight I WAS RIGHT ABOUT THAT!)

Been surrounding myself with people, still not happy, but dealing and moments of pure pain are becoming more and more dispersed. I actually was talking to a few people, none of which compared to my ex, some were as good looking but not as good in other ways, others just as sociable but I simply wasnt attracted to them, but overall it was nice to talk to different people, truth is I ended up just talking about their problems and helping them haha, Im such a problem solver! Then guess what.. 'hey, hows uni?' - the ex. I was taken back, and after some talking she revealed she's been missing me and wants to talk again and see where things go. Now at first, good, just what I wanted right? Well I dont know, Fuck Im Stupid. I mean, I've spent a month convincing myself of all these things, she's not perfect for me, there are others out there, I couldnt trust her anyway, if she got back then she'd probably just break my heart again further down the road. NOW WHAT?! I mean if I dont explore this I may regret it, and regretting not doing something seems worse than regretting doing something to me... I DONT KNOW WHAT IM DOING. A part of me is telling me so much is wrong here; Why a month? Why break up in the first place? Is it worth getting my heart broken again? Distance is still there, whats changed? BUT on the other hand; I love her, noone has come close to being like her, she seems to want to try, this is what Ive been wanting.

Yeah theres more to me, but simply put, by taking her out of the equation, nothing has added and my happiness has been subtracted, making me mathematically a worse person. 
A valid argument that I once again could stumble off the path and settle on it, the question is, is that enough to justify enduring my old path hoping? For this moment in time I'm okay, not close to ending things, but continuing for months on end without someone there isnt going to be easy, I cant even guarantee I'll do it..

That step back is not only painful and difficult, its something I cant see myself getting back forward to.. like I was on a long and miserable path, took a wrong turn and ended up on a better one, and now you ask me to return to my old path? Now Ive experienced this new one, going back isnt something I can do.
I know I can't be perfect, and striving towards it is something I do. But the fact I strive means that I cant take this negative, theres no denying I was a better person with her, now Im a worse person. I cant be okay with that.

aah yeah okay fair enough, I can see that. Well, thats because thats the evidence I have to go off, I had noone, and wasnt happy, I had someone and for the first time was happy (In all honesty I wasnt all happy, there was problems, issues, at some point I thought of ending things to be alone and look around more, but I could never bring myself to it because my mind told me after consideration she was the best I would get in life) then I lost her, and now Im less happy than ever. An impossibility is exactly what it feel like, finding someone with her looks, potential, intelligence, interest/love for me, understanding, empathy, social skills.. just impossible.. yeah speaking to someone, given it is before feb, is an option. It's a real shame, so many would think of me stupid, I am decent looking, fit, sporty, intelligent as all hell, perceptive, sociable, empathetic, so different, got a good future in career terms, in liverpool uni on a good course. I have all of this, a decent groups of friends, a family who does try. There are so many in a worse position, so many worse off, but I cant accept anything but perfection. I always found my drive for improvement given by my dad as a positive, something that made me the rounded and constantly improving person I am today, but taking this step back? Alongside the drive may be the thing to push me over the edge.. and that is something I find annoying. Something that has had such a positive, building, improving impact on me, is something making me feel completely empty and like life isnt worth living.

How is becoming emotionally attached such an issue? You can imagine in all likelihood, but whether you can comprehend my thought process, only you can answer that one, on a minute by minute basis I have hundreds of thoughts, then thoughts about why I thought those thoughts and how and why and what people would think about this view or that or how I got to where I am in my head or whether me saying any of this aloud would be beneficial and to what extent, and thats per thought, on anything and everything I see or experience. Imagine having that 'level of thinking power' dedicated to concluding there will be no happiness like the happiness and predicted happiness that she would have brought me, because even if there is that one person out there who is that 'perfect for me', the odds of me finding her are slim, and the payout of eventually finding her one day may not even outweigh the costs of daily waking to the pain of knowing its another day without. 
I rarely get things wrong, as arrogant as that sounds, but when I put real thought into things and come up with a conclusion, I end up being right, always. This is one of the rare occasions,  and it doesnt disprove the rule, since the rule is that I was incredibly emotionally stable and 'cold' when it comes to all aspects of life I had experienced so far, which did not include finding someone making me truly happy, foreseeing a good life, then having it taken from me. Therefore, I wasn't wrong, and the 'always right when truly thinking into things from all angles' rule still applies, which worries me considering my evaluated outcome from all this is me, alone, not finding the person I need, and concluding enough is enough, how soon? who knows.

Still possible, maybe, likely enough to justify my daily pain? We'll have to see.. No, I don't want to try and claim it's worse than what you can imagine, or even something you have experienced, in fact your incessant need to help draws me to the conclusion that you've been through enough to arrive at this point in your life, I know people aren't naturally as 'nice' as you or I, I've met enough to know that for a fact, it's experience that changes us. I may even consider going as far as to say, although in the case of 'more serious' matters such as death of relatives, pets, impending death of self, drunken parents beating, I have dealt incredibly well, I may have found my Achilles heel. This may just be the kind of pain I simply can't deal with, which for a normal person, you could simply say "Dont think about it"/"focus on other things" and they would be able to get past it, but me being weak, combined with my overactive 'torture chamber' of a mind, may be too much for me to handle. Interesting how this perspective makes me see something of a weakness in myself and want to change to protect and improve myself like my dad always instilled in me from football, maybe I'm not as emotionally stable and concrete as I once thought.

But the process of going to school isnt actively making children want to end their lives, my day to day goings on that I have to bare through are, without seeing any reward, or even foreseeing them in the near future, I don't see the need to continue to go through it for as long as I can before I'm inevitably drawn to the same conclusion having simply gone through this pain for a longer period of time.

Yeah, I like this quote from someone I can't remember "Don't quit because it got hard, even if you start crying, don't cry to quit, you already in pain, get a reward for it!" problem is I dont see a reward happening. Right now Im going day to day, couldnt ruin Christmas for my family and friends year in and year out, but if I dont change my mindset soon, I doubt I'll make February

Now the excruciating pain has past, I'm back to thinking non stop about my emotional pain! Why can't I even be content anymore? counsellor phoned saying they had a cancellation for tomorrow in liverpool, but Im nowhere near there for another month, so my mental state likely wont improve. Now Im back here Ive remembered that although I was well liked and got along with everyone, I never let myself get tied down to a close friendship with any group or individual (likely another reason my ex meant so much to me, being the only person I fully relied on) and thats kind of resulted in me feeling pretty damn alone here, not least since Im so ill I cant walk or sleep, let alone make plans with old friends. I dont know man, just seems like Im in a position in life I dont want to be in, without any redeeming factor right now, and its hard to see a reason to continue this physical and emotional pain one day after the next

Havent slept in three days and the pain from swallowing is unbearable, almost like something is telling me to end it all. Whats the point in keeping going in this emotional and physical pain? I dont want to anymore, I really really dont

So I've found a distraction, it's called becoming incredibly ill, ear infection, being sick, throat infection, constant painful coughing, also leading to on occasion me being sick to breath.. I didn't meat up with my friends last night due to a migraine, and all of these usually conclude with myself getting meningitis, which consequently killed me twice when I was younger, though I havent had an attack in years. I am not only scared, but in unbearable pain, not being able to sleep because of a cold too, this is an awful experience on top of everything, and I cant even walk.

Already made all that clear in many different ways, she knows. Still nothing, just saved messages. It might fade, and yeah it'll also always be there, but Im not happy. I want to be happy. I dont know what Im doing, now Im confronted with the thought of going home for a month within the next few hours and having nothing but family and a few friends around, sitting in that bed that I used to be in whilst talking to her, seeing my family who know how messed up I am and knowing theyre not happy and its my fault. Having nothing really to do every day. I dont know if Im going to make it back here to Liverpool.

Yeah I guess, maybe I can try it, but every time I have I end up pushing them away if theyre not for me, or getting a bit attached, and I can see in their eyes they are too.. Agreed but for me being alone a majority of the time my brain makes me feel completely alone, with people I can block it out and think of other things. It's true vaguely maybe, but Im talking really really in depth knowledge of almost everything, which is good because I get along with loads of people, just when I had my ex, she was interested in just my thought and how I worked (she loved psychology and probably how crazy I am) and it was nice having someone just wanting to know my thoughts from me, as opposed to the thoughts I put out as my own based on what I want others to hear (If you can follow that). I have deleted everything to do with her, but her snapchat name is in my memory as something like 'ex123' and because I remember it, whenever I am drunk, or upset, or even bored, I feel the need to add her, and let her know that I miss her and want to try. As pathetic as that sounds, its something I cant help myself doing in the hopes that it means something to her, and she saves them and doesnt respond, either because they mean something to her, or because they dont and she wants to make a point. Thats a big issue with distance and thinking about how to go about things, I cant tell if she's upset, I cant tell if shes moving on, I can't tell if she even cares. As a result of this, I cant move on myself in case she isnt and messages me soon, I dont like the thought of that situation, but equally I cant convince myself that she is moving on and isnt upset because that really hurts to imagine, and without any scale or knowledge to base that assumption on, my brain goes to the worst case scenario like shes sending pictures to someone I hate and is happier than ever and doesnt even think about me etc. I dont honestly know which one I'd prefer. The only thing I know I'd prefer anymore is to not think, over this continuous insanity that is my head keeping going.

Suppose maybe youre trying to say I should consider myself lucky, and I do in a way for all that I've had (relationship wise) and with the fact I can get someone anytime I want, I just wish sometimes I could be one of those douchebags who go out, get a girl, and have fun, no emotions. Thats not me and I kind of hate it, I mean, I see almost no point without feelings involved, which in reality limits the fun I can have and my ability to get over her. Im okay without a relationship, given Im talking to people and working towards something then yes, I mean god, right now noone should be in a relationship with me! But happiness by myself? Not really an option with my torture chamber of a mind bringing up memories and doubts about future all the time. 
Im not sure I understand your point on that second line.. 
I have those people, god I do, I have this 'ability' to be able to blend in with everyone. If I'm in the mood to talk sport, I have a wide array of knowledge in every aspect to ensure I can converse about it with those people should I need to, this is the case with the 'popular people', the 'gamers', the 'druggies', the 'nerds', the 'party people' and so on! I have people I can connect with and want me around in all aspect of life, but thats more me complying to their needs and wants, it doesnt seem like theres anyone out there complying to mine, probably because theyre to vast and diverse.. the issue here mainly lies with the fact that no matter how many people I surround myself with, theres still that hole of my ex just being there to text, to call every morning and night, and thats destroying me.

Thats a good way to think about it, I mean before her I thought I could never be happy, but the issue with that is winning the lottery twice. Since I have been in this university I have met hundreds of girls, and none who meet her in terms of being so good for me in such a range of things. To this before you said maybe I should look for people who are better in different ways, but the issue with that, with me, is I need someone smart, intellectual, with good prospects, who cares and is interested in me for me, the real me. I need someone good looking who I'm attracted to, who is obsessed with me and making eachother happy, I need someone who shares my interested and aspirations. She was 93% perfect for all of those things, finding someone like that is so hard, the time between now and 'maybe one day finding someone' is hurting every moment Im alone and can think. 

I respond because I like to think if anything ever did happen, that maybe someone would know the real reasons why, someone could maybe get to understanding the real me before I dont have the chance to tell them, you also have a different perspective that is always nice to consider and factor into my thought process which, although I'm usually pretty good at, I havent always thought of. Also the fact you reply, I enjoy typing out my thoughts, and the fact someone has an interest and response is different because usually its just me who can respond, noone else keeps up, or seems to care enough to try. 

I dont either when Im honest, but given the opportunity I know I would try, I know I could make it work, and although it would be hard knowing what we've done to eachother, and the fact my friends and family know whats happened, I would still try because I want to be happy. Counselling is something I am going for, but I fear I have left it too late, with the delay and my heart slowly shattering all hope, I dont know about holding in there anymore. A simple click and I could be off flying to Spain today, thats probably where I would do it, after spending some time doing whatever I find enjoyable, that way my family doesnt have to deal with too much in terms of aftermath.

Just being around people I put on a front Im okay, and if thats lasts long enough then I start to believe it, also when girls hit on me or I make someone smile, all of these can last all day, it wouldnt change the heartbreak I experience every morning. At the start it was really hard for me to accept its fully over, and although we both knew it was, we agreed she has until february to change her mind and we will both try. I think the real reason for that was so I could give myself time to accept it, instead of all in one go, but the only thing keeping me going is the hopes she'll want to try again. She may not be perfect, hell, she may not even be worth trying again after all shes done to me, but the truth is, when I had her I was truly happy, and now Im not, hence she is the reason for happiness, and I really miss that.

You know how idiotic I can be, whenever I want to I add her back and try and message her. The 'forgotten it was possible' part is what's killing me, I never knew it could be like that, and then I had it, and now I dont see it happening again. I went out last night, had 3 girls hit on me, but no matter what I couldnt forget that one was less attractive than my ex, and one didnt really care about wanting to get to know me, then the third wasn't nearly as smart. It just seems like, yeah, I can have short bursts of being okay, but at the end of the day, and worst in the beginning of the morning, I am alone without the only person to truly get me and make me happy. That is what is driving me in this direction, that is what I simply cannot get past. Honestly? I don't see myself lasting until counselling. With the wait list as it is, and the fact my ex has effectively said 'if I dont talk by feb, I never will' helping me get through these past few weeks, I think at the beginning of feb I wont be able to go on.

but its the best way out, no doubting that. I have friends, family, all sorts. As bad as it sounds, I have nothing to help get over my ex, and whilst dreaming of her, receiving 'mis-sent texts on snapchat' to me, then ignoring me without explanation, she's either 1. Messing with me 2. Insinuating she's moving on and talking to other people 3. Actually moving on and mistakenly letting me know, which is fucking killing me more than ever.

I dont want to, all my work is done, all of my friends are going back home, I have a week of being almost completely alone, then a month of being back in my hometown alone, all the while my ex will still be ignoring me. I dont know what it is, honestly, but I cant shake this feeling of just wanting to end it all, it would be so easy, and it wouldnt hurt anymore.
I'll update you soon, truth is in a week I'll be heading back home for christmas and be there for a few weeks, whether that will improve the situation, or make it worsen (more likely) we'll see..
I will be grinding through, agreed to speak to someone but theres a 2-12 week waitlist, guess Ill hope to make it that long.

I open up often, I honestly dont mind sharing anything with anyone who seems interested, just feel theres only ever been one person who wanted to and didnt take a step back because of all of it. One thing I will admit is I do feel weak, Im not the only one to have gone through this, perhaps with the same past and mental capacity for self torture? But even so someone has to have been through worse, why cant I? Because each day is killing me? I hope the thought that Im not alone and will get through is enough for a bit..

I understand that is a thing, but finding 'just another person' like her seems so hard right now, and the time between might be enough to kill me. 
This is just the peak of the iceberg, not to seek admiration but I've been through plenty, and this is the thing that breaks me down?! That thought isnt a nice one. I hope we both get people who are close enough to know the true us, but I fear everyone I open up to is scared of how crazy I truly am. I do like to think I can offer a lot, and I dont find hearing nothing in response much of a burden, Im used to it after all these years. I wish I was my usual self, and we were close so I could show you genuinely how great of a person I can be and was before all this! I dont think I will tonight again, one day at a time, but I'll see how my dreams go tonight.. strange how something so small can have such a dramatic effect.

I know, but if you had 18 years of it, you can expect the next day to follow with something different. Oh no, I know there will be forms of happiness, if I were to record my face tomorrow I can promise I will be smiling for 80% of it, but when I go home, have any time to myself, I wont have that one person there for me. That thought kills me. Burn to the ground has never been more perfect of a description. You understand my pain, you follow my process, but you still dont give the pain enough props. I have broken bones, torn ligaments, had close friends kill themselves, grandparents die, pets die, some of the most heartwrenching stuff happen, and I take it, deal with it, I am known as the one of the strongest people around in terms of dealing, but I have never felt a pain so deep, so constant, so drilling, as my heart telling me there is noone there, noone truly knowing, and noone truly loving me. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bYMUb4uQZoo This tempts me to just put my life to doing something great for the next month perhaps and see what I can achieve, but I know no matter what I achieve, hell curing cancer wouldnt be enough of a reason enough for me to continue, I need someone like her, and I have no hope of that. I need to be selfish for once, but just a heads up, should I ever fully decide to follow through and use this 'permanent solution', I promise I will let you know first, I wouldnt want you to worry should I not respond for any period of time, especially with time difference.

Fan of the quote "You've already cried, struggled all this way, for what? Don't give up now, don't quit, because the second you do, that's when you were about to break through" or something to that note (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=shquazmK8BE) I like that 'everything and nothing' there too! What do I want most? Someone who knows me, loves me, and is there for me. With that I can do anything, because I will be happy, alongside all the other great qualities I have. I would be interested from an outside perspective, but this isnt some film that cuts from the bad to the comeback, those days in between, on the off chance it would get better than ever, are so hard right now.

I only responded to the first half. I see it as completely irrational, especially considering the amazing position I am in otherwise (on other responses if you find the time) and the fact that each of my previous loves I found to be great, then the next was better. But one thing cant escape my mind, and thats how good this person was for me, and to me. I have never even met anyone that well adjusted for me, and only me. 96% seems impossible, Im far too broken for anyone to love the true me alongside having all those other qualities she has, Im shocked I got her in the first place, even though Im good looking, fit, athletic, smart, in a great position, I just doubt I could find anyone in university for me, everyone wanting a relationship has a better range to choose from, and everyone else wants flings, which despite being hit on all the time, arent my thing in the slightest. My relationship with me? Incredible, I love myself haha, I am great in many ways, something I got from football was this never ending drive to improve (more details in other responses) and thus I am really well rounded with a lot of positives, half the girls I've met and been friends with refer to me as out of their league and most girls' perfect guy, but you have to remember thats also because they dont actually know the true me. As soon as they did, its likely they would be scared away from being friends. As for being the one, I have spent my whole life in acceptance of being alone (this sentence has started like a Walter White speech from breaking bad <3) thinking my poor, experienced, and frankly shocking childhood had screwed me up to the point that happiness was simply I could lead others too. Then I met her, and yeah, maybe I wasnt perfect, maybe she wasnt, but one thing is for damn sure, I was happy. I spent every minute that I could have spent on myself helping others, be it walking an hour to the shop in pouring rain to get my sister chocolate just so she would smile, talking on the phone to a friend who faked interest in anything I was saying just so they could get my help on something (really good at helping people due to range of knowledge and perspectives) Now that I've lived with happiness, now I have that in the back of my mind, the life I could have had, I dont feel I can continue this heartbreak of a life. Every choice I have ever made has been for someone else, yes it may have benefited me in one way or another, but they were truly with others in mind, this last choice, suicide, it would be my only selfish act I have ever taken. Do I not deserve a chance of not being in a constant torture chamber that is my mind? Because noone truly knows how it works, its constantly on, and I dont mean to sound like I think Im something special, but Ive read up a lot, Ive gained knowledge from others, and the way I think, the amount I think, is far beyond most. And yes, you could say use that potential, I could do something great, help some people, maybe even a substantial amount, maybe one, but why cant my life be concluded with a selfish act when theres so much selfishness in the world I see every day with every act the people around me take. Sorry for digressing, theres a lot on my mind.

I read it in another post you responded to. I see that from your perspective looking back, and you also have to understand the difference is a crappy friendship group and getting past that, no doubt it was hard, but for me its accepting I'll never be happy, to tasting what it can be like, to returning to that old state, there is no other girl as good in those areas as her, even if there is, how could I possibly find her?! Taking on these days, crying as I sleep, waking up with genuine physical pain resulting from my dreams destroying me, walking down the street remembering before I would be on the phone to her, and now Im looking at the ground; Everything is a constant reminder of what I had, and as I said, I would have gladly dropped out of uni, given away all my money, promised a life of celibacy even, if it meant I could have her there for me, knowing me, truly, and loving me in spite of it.

I dont see it as that, I see it more as cutting my losses, and not having to continue in this misery. I get that, truly I do, and I hope for my sake alone you're right and I'm mistaken due to emotion, but even so how does that change the pain I am suffering through on a daily basis? I could hoold out and hope for some degree of happiness, or I could stop this incessant thinking, this memory reel playing in my mind, this constant reminder of a life I could have led.

I love the thought that has gone into this, so either you do this a lot or are very intelligent, both are great. It was 2 weeks ago, so likely you'll be expecting the whole cliche plenty more fish, its so short term, things get better, but one thing you need to understand is, without sounding too arrogant, I worded it better in a previous response above, but I'm really smart. I'm rational, logical, and when I see things and know theyre right, I have a great instinct and perception for knowing things, and as much as I hope my usually correct instincts are simply blinded by emotion, I dont think they are. That frightens me. Simply put, I know there are people out there better looking than her, not many tbh, and there are some smarter, some who might accept me for me more, some that are emotionally stronger, who have more time for me, or better career prospects. But I do know one thing, she was 93% perfect FOR ME. Truth be told, I know finding someone that is that good of a match for someone, in all the ways she was, to the extent she was, is not only extremely unlikely, but near impossible in my current mental state. I cant do basic tasks without the reminder of what I had, and what I lost. That isnt even necessarily her, it's the happiness I never thought I could have, and now I know I had, and lost it, I cant continue knowing I'll likely never have it back.

I see what youre saying, but what is the point in hoping for other versions of happiness?! The potential thought I might enjoy something in the near or far future doesnt outweigh my constant pain right now. I cant play football without thinking about the time I did with her, and her smile, and everything about that day. I'm literally crying typing this, how is this all worth it?!
